support_claim: Both referents are associated with the name Meridian Energy Partners LLC and the contract context, but the packet lacks establishing identity evidence such as a shared legal identifier or an explicit uniqueness claim, so neither SAME_ENTITY nor DISTINCT is licensed.

steps.fact: The left referent is billing:Meridian Energy Partners LLC and the right referent is contract:MSA-MER-2024.
The billing observation names the billed party as Meridian Energy Partners LLC.
Contract MSA-MER-2024 lists its counterparty as Meridian Energy Partners LLC.
Commercial notes associate Meridian Energy Partners invoices with the advisory retainer under MSA-MER-2024.
The packet provides no shared legal identifier, no statement that the name uniquely identifies one entity, and no explicit identity bridge between the billing referent and the contract referent.
Shared counterparty name and contextual association do not meet the burden for SAME_ENTITY; no evidence establishes distinctness for DISTINCT.
